description: Running a subset of unit test files loses fixtures that live in conftest.py files. With the 20 slowest unit test files run together (serially with -p no:xdist, or with -n 6), 48 tests error with "fixture 'flow_repos' not found" (apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/stages/test_children.py, test_plan_decision.py, test_plan_resume_adopts_branch.py, test_integration.py and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_git_refs.py) and 5 tests fail in tests/flow/review/test_conflict_gate.py and tests/flow/test_pipeline.py. Each file passes alone, and so does the full unit selection. A second observation: when tests/flow/stages/test_replan_request.py is listed after a parent-directory file that follows other stages/ files (for example 'stages/test_children.py flow/test_git_refs.py stages/test_replan_request.py'), its eight cases error with "fixture 'no_origin_reconcile' not found", serially and under xdist; listing the stages/ files contiguously passes. The fixtures are defined in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/conftest.py (flow_repos, _flow_repos_template) and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/stages/conftest.py (no_origin_reconcile). The cause is probably conftest discovery order or a test module that shadows the tests.flow package; bisect the file lists to the pair that triggers it first.
goal: Find the root cause by bisecting, then fix it so that any selection of unit test files, in any argument order, serial or under xdist, sees the same fixtures as the full run. Prefer the smallest fix in the conftest files and test packaging (for example making fixture visibility independent of argument order, or removing the shadowing import). Add a regression test that runs pytest in a subprocess over a file list that reproduces each failure (the flow_repos case and the no_origin_reconcile case) and asserts no fixture-not-found error. No test is weakened, skipped or deleted.
rationale: Flows that re-measure only their in-scope test files hit false fixture errors, and the order dependence can hide a real failure.
acceptance_criteria: Running 'uv run pytest -p no:xdist' over the 20-file list that failed before (test_children, test_plan_decision, test_plan_resume_adopts_branch, test_integration, test_git_refs, test_conflict_gate, test_pipeline and the other slowest files) has no 'fixture not found' error and no failure that the full run does not show.
A regression test covers both file-list orders and fails on the old code.
The full unit selection still passes via 'uv run pytest'; test count does not drop.
No file outside the scope list changes; the module budgets file and every budget-check script are untouched.
